services.name: Past Exhibits
services.desc: Our Potential, Our Purpose is an interactive exhibit that explores how communities around the world are building opportunity, resilience, and positive change. Through stories, visuals, and hands-on elements, visitors are invited to reflect on global challenges and shared solutions, and discover how individuals and communities are shaping a more inclusive and sustainable future. This exhibit showcases people taking on big challenges like inequality and climate change, and explore what it means to be part of a global community and imagine your role in a world full of potential. services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: Located on the boardwalk at Westminster Quay and steps away from downtown New Westminster, the Fraser River Discovery Centre (FRDC) offers a creative and unique venue for a wide variety of special events. The atmosphere is accentuated by the exhibits currently showing on both floors, and with panoramic views of the mighty Fraser River, the FRDC is an ideal location for social events, business meetings, ceremonies, workshops, and standup receptions. The FRDC is a registered charity. services.name: Guided Tours
services.desc: The Fraser River is filled with stories of those who live and work along the Fraser River. Currently the FRDC offers two tour options to bring these stories to life: indoor Exhibit Tours of both floors of the Centre’s galleries, and outdoor Quayside Tours along the New Westminster Quay.
